event_chain.summary: Vulnerability in PIS web portal exploited
39.7 GB of port operator records exfiltrated and leaked on a forum

summary: In early April 2026 a threat actor known as 'marssepe' (Sociedad Privada 157) posted on a cybercrime forum data allegedly taken from the Mexican Navy (SEMAR)'s Puerto Inteligente Seguro (PIS) port access platform, reportedly covering about 640,000 port operators (names, CURP, RFC, social security numbers, blood types, facial photos, employment details and access-control identifiers). ASIPONA Manzanillo detected a post about the possible breach on April 5, activated security protocols, changed PIS passwords and disabled direct external-IP access to the database; SEMAR made no statement. In May 2026 the same journalist alleged a much larger 5.8 TB exposure of PIS operational records.
